text: A heap-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read) exists in mpz_get_int (mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c): the function can read past the allocated bigint limb array (e.g. accessing y->p[1] beyond the allocation). This can be triggered during bigint comparisons (mrb_bint_cmp / num_gt) and may lead to crashes or other undefined behavior.
